Ava (Finance): Team - LatencyBucket reports a burst charge stacked on top of their reserved commit for 2026-05-10 11:05-11:20 UTC. Looks like the same tokens were billed twice. Can billing confirm?
Diego (Billing): I'm seeing INV-2026-0899. There's a reserved commit line and a burst/overage line referencing nodepool lb-prod-primary for overlapping minutes.
Priya (CS): LatencyBucket did a small planned rollover that window. We expected traffic to land on their reserved pool; not sure why burst appeared.
Ethan (Ops): Pulling metering export + autoscaler logs. If the autoscaler relabeled the instance mid-request, exporter might have emitted two meter records for same request.
billing-bot: Auto-scan: INV-2026-0899 contains identical meter_id entries in both reserved_bucket and burst_bucket for nodepool lb-prod-primary. Flagging for manual reconciliation.
Ava (Finance): Please attach metering CSV for lb-prod-primary 10:55-11:25 UTC. Need to estimate the duplicated token count.
Ethan (Ops): Exported. Quick excerpt: ```
2026-05-10T11:12:03Z lb-prod-primary reserved_bucket tokens=7,200 meter_id=mi-cc77
2026-05-10T11:12:03Z lb-prod-primary burst_bucket tokens=7,200 meter_id=mi-cc77
```
Priya (CS): That meter_id match = double-count. Customer finance already pinged support. We should offer interim relief.
Nora (AcctMgr): Agreed. Ethan, what's the root cause and is there a patch ETA?
Ethan (Ops): Root cause: autoscaler tag-update race where instance label changed from "reserved" to "burst-eligible" mid-export. Fix merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/311 deployed 2026-05-11 03:45 UTC. Full audit CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-billing-audits/2026-05/latencybucket-dup-2468009999.csv
Diego (Billing): Ava, estimate for duplicated tokens?
Ava (Finance): Duplicate tokens ~7,200 -> ~$54. To be safe propose provisional credit $75 (covers rounding/tax) and offer 4 days waived burst allowance as goodwill.
Priya (CS): CS supports goodwill offer and plain-English explanation. Nora, can you approve provisional?
Nora (AcctMgr): Approved for provisional credit $75 and the 4-day waiver. I'll review the customer note before send.
Diego (Billing): Creating provisional credit memo now; will tag as provisional_credit and hold final adj until Ops confirms full reconciliation.
Diego (Billing): CM-2026-PROV-511 created and applied to INV-2026-0899 on 2026-05-15. billing_note=autoscaler_label_race_duplicate_metering
billing-bot: Ticket created: BILL-3799 - "LatencyBucket duplicate metering - provisional credit issued" assigned to Diego.
Ava (Finance): Please mark the invoice as under_review and include billing_note=duplicate_autoscaler_label in the ledger.
Diego (Billing): Done. Marked INV-2026-0899 under_review and updated BILL-3799 with audit links.
Ethan (Ops): Reached out to cloud-metering team; they observed duplicate attach/log rows correlated with autoscaler label updates. They're reviewing.
Priya (CS): I'll draft the customer-facing email: "We've applied a provisional credit of $75 and are completing a reconciliation. We'll follow up within 7 business days with the final numbers and a short explanation." Nora will review before sending.
Nora (AcctMgr): Sounds good. Hold off on external comms until provider confirmation ideally, but the provisional credit gives immediate relief.
Ava (Finance): Thanks everyone. Closing loop once final audit posted to BILL-3799.
Diego (Billing): Noted  provisional credit applied; will update when final reconciliation complete.
Ava (Finance): Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
